title: Glowfruit

story.intro: A glowfruit rests on the path. Carry it past the thorns to the shrine.
story.success: The shrine takes the glowfruit from Nia's hands.
story.blocked: Leave the fruit behind and the shrine stays dark.

hints: The fruit is one step east.
Pick it up before you leave that tile.
Carry it one more step to the shrine.
